# GDAS generating-process proof corpus

These are real NOMADS `filter_gdas_0p25.pl` subsets from cycle
`gdas.20260729/12/atmos`, retrieved 2026-07-30.  Each is the complete
124-record gpuwm selector over the 2x2 grid at 30..30.25 N,
260..260.25 E.

| File | Hour | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `nomads-gdas-20260729t12z-f000.grib2` | 0 | 22,518 | `046ff2dade6e08e921e18c0ad75dccc4e43d1f8dc47c550cfa9be9d3323d2afe` |
| `nomads-gdas-20260729t12z-f003.grib2` | 3 | 22,531 | `afa3f6b83c159ae7cfb2ce9425c36aa003a8163e8edc91911c79b776b5d4919a` |
| `nomads-gdas-20260729t12z-f006.grib2` | 6 | 22,535 | `581bcf5d8bce2abd39392d449013d46c52ba9b60b732b5585d6a5922eb47227c` |
| `nomads-gdas-20260729t12z-f009.grib2` | 9 | 22,561 | `1df03c6114a039dc4ffdfe96974c216b0311834e629d5966c424805dfe0b7f5f` |

The f009 row is the **published endpoint** of `GDAS_MAX_FORECAST_HOUR`,
and it is here for exactly that reason: with the corpus stopping at
f006, the last certified hour rested on a Python constant rather than
on bytes.  It was retrieved 2026-07-30 from the same cycle as its three
siblings, by the same 2x2 recipe, so the four files differ only in the
forecast hour.

The Rust regression parses all 124 messages in every file and freezes
this signature:

- centre 7, master table 2, local table 1;
- PDT 4.0, generating-process type 2, background-process ID 0;
- forecast-process ID 81 at f000 and 96 at f003/f006/f009;
- forecast time equal to the declared hour;
- GDT 3.0, shape 6, 0.25-degree increments, scan `0x40`;
- DRT 5.0 simple packing;
- 124 messages at each hour, matching the frozen selector census.

It also presents each real forecast file to the analysis-only process
policy and requires refusal.  Process 96 is therefore a declared
capability backed by these bytes, never a blanket rule for nonzero
hours.  The independent raw-S3 DRT 5.3 refusal corpus remains under
`tests/fixtures/gfs-scan-order/`.

The crops are intentionally tiny.  NOMADS omits a bitmap when every
cell in such a crop is present, so this regression supplies the
observed bitmap policy while exercising `validate_common`; it does not
claim that the 2x2 files pass the bridge's separate, unchanged
missing-value-policy gate.

## Retrieval

The URLs were generated by
`tools.download_gfs_native_subset.nomads_query` with model `gdas`,
cycle `2026-07-29T12`, and the bounds above.  That query uses the same
variable/level declaration as `gpuwm fetch`, including all 21 pressure
levels and the surface/soil records.

NCEP model output is a work of the U.S. Government and is in the public
domain.
